Obtain the information about of an eLTER dataset.

Source: R/get_dataset_info.R
get_dataset_info.Rd

This function obtains the information about of an eLTER dataset (e.g. https://deims.org/dataset/38d604ef-decb-4d67-8ac3-cc843d10d3ef) provided in DEIMS-SDR catalogue.

Usage

get_dataset_info(datasetid, show_map = FALSE)

Arguments

datasetid

A character. It is the DEIMS ID of dataset make from DEIMS-SDR website. DEIMS ID information here. The DEIMS ID of dataset is the URL for the dataset page.

show_map

A boolean. If TRUE a Leaflet map with occurrences is shown. Default FALSE.

Value

The output of the function is a list with two elements:

  • map A Leaflet map with the dataset location, if requested with show_map.

  • data A data.frame with the information about the dataset.

The function output

Author

Alessandro Oggioni, phD (2020) oggioni.a@irea.cnr.it

Examples

tDataset <- get_dataset_info(
  datasetid =
  "https://deims.org/dataset/38d604ef-decb-4d67-8ac3-cc843d10d3ef",
  show_map = TRUE
)
tDataset
